paragraphs: R' Ḥanina bar Kahana. See the entry R' Ḥinana bar Kahana.[^1]

notes.text: The heading has חנינא, Ḥanina; the target has חיננא, here provisionally Ḥinana. The different consonantal forms and conventional vowels are retained, rather than treating the English vocalization as verified. Both abbreviated titles remain R'.
